status: preregistered before any increment-9 download, cgroup forward or oracle run

fp32_comparison.rule: abs(error) <= atol + rtol*abs(reference) for every element

fp64_comparison.rule: same rule; increment-7 FP64 thresholds, unchanged

tolerance_policy: increment 7/8 thresholds reused unchanged; never widened after measurement

cgroup.mechanism: systemd-run --user --scope transient unit under the delegated user manager

conditions.W_buffered_warm: checkpoint resident in global page cache charged to another cgroup before start; documents that such pages are not charged to the scope
conditions.P_pressure: POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED on the experiment file only, residency checked with fincore before start; every page the run needs is faulted under the 2 GiB scope

pass_criteria: worker in the scope before opening weights (checked from inside)
memory.max=2147483648 and memory.swap.max=0 observed in the scope
complete forward; logits/hidden/KV digests byte-identical to the increment-8 accepted captures AND full parity with the increment-8 FP32 oracle at fp32_comparison thresholds
condition P shows block reads (proc io read_bytes > 0) proving pages were (re)read under the limit
phase_a.not_a_pass: a W-only run, a run whose pages were charged elsewhere, or any OOM kill

phase_b.expected_unique_active_bf16_bytes: payload - embedding (152064*3584*2) + embedding rows actually read; recomputed from catalog and per-tensor counters
phase_b.criterion: unique BF16 bytes actively used by the forward > MemTotal measured at the start of the same run

sequence.mode: sync first; pipeline only if justified

phase_b.memory: explicit runtime arena budget = plan; RLIMIT_AS applied; optional 2 GiB scope if phase A passes; no WSL/swap reconfiguration

oracles.implementation: upstream Transformers Qwen2 modules executed one decoder layer at a time, weights loaded tensor-by-tensor from the original shards; no InWiMe import

contracts.full64: Qwen2 upstream graph with RMSNorm/RoPE/softmax in FP64 (increment-7 profile) - mathematical parity
contracts.stock_fp64_diagnostic: raw verdict always reported, never rewritten

oracles.coverage_required_for_full_pass: all logits of every position, residual output of all 28 layers, K post-RoPE and V of all layers, argmax/greedy equality
oracles.fallback: if any contract is infeasible, record exact coverage and mark F NOT PROVEN for that contract

io_policy.eviction: POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED on experiment files only, verified with fincore
counters: Windows PhysicalDisk raw read bytes (global, host)
io_policy.io.stat: unavailable: io controller not enabled in root cgroup.subtree_control

resource_safety.action: cgroup.kill of the experiment scope only

gate.F: independent numerical verification with declared coverage
gate.G: memory/swap within declared limits, no system OOM

amendments.before: any phase A or phase B measurement
amendments.evidence: cgroup-probe-128mib.json: 300 MB random file on ext4, scope memory.max=128 MiB, DONTNEED eviction verified (300003328 -> 0 resident), two sequential reads: memory.peak == memory.max exactly, memory.events max=219, oom_kill=0, 600 MB block reads
amendments.change: phase_a pass criterion memory.peak < memory.max replaced by memory.peak <= memory.max with oom/oom_kill = 0 and swap 0; file cache legitimately fills the scope to the limit and is reclaimed there. Anonymous+kernel charge must stay well below the limit and is reported separately.
amendments.reason: strict inequality would turn correct kernel enforcement into a spurious FAIL; criterion fixed before measuring the experiment
